name: Hydrokinesis
description: Ability to mentally control, manipulate, solidify, and direct water currents, waves, and water pressure.
limitations: Requires proximity to moisture or extreme physical exertion to draw underground water.

name: Personal Hurricane
description: Summons a surrounding miniature hurricane of water, rushing wind, and lightning sparks.

name: Curse of Achilles Invulnerability
description: Nigh-invulnerable skin acquired by bathing in the River Styx.
limitations: Instant death if struck on the small of his back (Achilles spot).

name: Electrokinesis
description: Ability to generate, channel, and direct static electricity and electrical lightning discharges.

name: Necromancy & Undead Command
description: Ability to summon skeletal warriors, communicate with shades/ghosts, and command Underworld spirits.
limitations: Requires graveyard soil or Stygian iron for massive army summons.

name: Shadow Travel
description: Ability to step into darkness/shadows and teleport vast distances across the mortal world or Underworld.
limitations: Causes extreme physical fatigue and risk of fading into shadows permanently if overused.

name: Panic Scream
description: Emits the ancient primal shout of Pan that induces overwhelming terror and frenzy in enemy forces.
limitations: Drains satyr vitality and can only be used during severe crisis.

name: Strategic Genius & Architectural Intuition
description: Hyper-analytical mind capable of instant battle tactics, complex structural analysis, and solving ancient puzzles.

name: Ares Combat Frenzy & Intimidation
description: Superhuman battle prowess, weapon mastery, and aura of fear that inspires allies and terrifies foes.
limitations: Can cause rash and reckless tactical decisions.

name: Charmspeak & Persuasion
description: Vocal persuasion that subtly compels listeners to agree or comply with spoken commands.
limitations: Less effective on strong-willed target entities.

name: Pyrokinesis & Forge Mastery
description: High resistance to fire/heat and innate mastery over metalworking, mechanics, and explosives.
limitations: Requires raw materials and tools for complex mechanical creations.

name: Superhuman Strength & Invulnerability
description: Colossal physical power capable of lifting mountains, wrestling divine beasts, and overpowering giants.
limitations: Prone to fits of divine rage.

name: Equestrian Mastery
description: Innate ability to communicate with, calm, and master mythical equine creatures like Pegasus.
limitations: Requires Athena's golden bridle to tame wild Pegasus initially.

name: Hypnotic Vocal Enchantment
description: Enchanted vocal singing that places mortals, demigods, and monsters into a helpless trance of applause.
limitations: Blocked by earplugs or divine music.
